**1.035: Models always stay up to date; the Models screen lists only what your phone can run.**

- **Model updates are always on:** downloaded models update themselves in the background (about every 6 hours); the switch to turn that off is gone. "Only on Wi-Fi" is still there.
- **Checked right after an app update:** when Hebrish itself is updated, it looks for newer model versions straight away instead of waiting.
- **Models screen:** models that only run on a computer (the Qwen and Canary variants of Sabich, Shakshuka) are no longer listed. A model you already have stays.
- **Also in this release (1.034):** a Hebrew-only model that writes in Hebrew letters, used when your keyboard is in Hebrew, with an EN / עב button in the voice keyboard. It is [Zipformer2 66M by Yakov Kolani](https://huggingface.co/ivrit-ai/zipformer2-66m-streaming-he), trained on [ivrit.ai](https://www.ivrit.ai) data, CC BY 4.0, unchanged.
- Not yet tested on a device. arm64-v8a only. Android 9+. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
